Deterministic analysis classifies the short-term structure as coherent descending, bounded by nearby defined support and resistance, while the long-term structure is transition.
The latest three sessions show consecutive bullish closes, creating a positive lower-timeframe impulse that conflicts with the descending trading-timeframe classification.
Short-horizon ATR materially exceeds ATR(14), indicating expanding realized dispersion rather than the earlier compressed-volatility condition.
Latest volume is below its 20-session average after two above-average sessions; participation has faded during the latest rebound and does not provide persistent directional confirmation.
Multiple failed highs form an overhead resistance pattern, while the current rebound is close to nearby support-resistance boundaries rather than a confirmed range resolution.
